items.title: Reverse engineering my e-scooter and rewriting the firmware in rust
items.blurb: I reverse engineered the hardware and firmware of my Egret GT E-Scooter. I describe how I got in, analysed communication between components, and reverse engineered firmware. I speak about writing custom firmware for the display unit.
